Package io.milvus.orm.iterator

  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    IteratorAdapterV2
    Adapter that converts between the v2 iterator request classes (QueryIteratorReq, SearchIteratorReq) and the legacy v1 iterator parameters used internally by the iterator implementations.
    IteratorCache
    Thread-safe cache of query results used by the query and search iterators to paginate data.
    QueryIterator
    Iterates over query results in batches using a session timestamp and primary-key based cursor, supporting offset seeking, resumable cursors, and element-filter iteration.
    QueryIteratorCursor
    A serializable snapshot of a QueryIterator position, used to resume pagination from where a previous iterator left off (pymilvus parity: QueryIterator.get_cursor() / QueryIteratorCursor).
    QueryIteratorCursor.QueryIteratorCursorBuilder
    Builder for QueryIteratorCursor class.
    RpcStubWrapper
    Wrapper around a Milvus gRPC blocking stub that carries the endpoint and database name of the client it was created from, and applies the per-call RPC deadline used by the iterators.
    SearchIterator
    Iterator that paginates through the results of a vector search.
    SearchIteratorV2
    Server-side iterator for paginating vector search results using the Search Iterator V2 protocol.
